name: sucun-vault
description: A local encrypted desktop vault for macOS
author: CodeBlossom-smlend

scripts.dev: concurrently -k "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && npm run build:main && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
scripts.format: prettier --write src tests README.md CONTRIBUTING.md package.json tsconfig.electron.json tsconfig.renderer.json vite.config.mts electron-builder.yml .github .prettierrc.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src tests README.md CONTRIBUTING.md package.json tsconfig.electron.json tsconfig.renderer.json vite.config.mts electron-builder.yml .github .prettierrc.json
scripts.dev:win: npm run generate:windows && npm run dev
scripts.package:win: npm run generate:windows && npm run build && electron-builder --win
